{{Top|leg}}
The '''Morjanssik Sanitation Bureau''' was an organization that operated in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Morjanssik]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. For a while, the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Moren Chonk]] served as the leader of the Bureau and due to his success running the Bureau, Chonk was elected as the city's [[Chief Manager]].
